title: Elixr HUD
description:
📝 Project Summary: ElixrUI

ElixrUI is a lightweight aesthetic overhaul for Minecraft that transforms the traditional HUD into a Cinematic Experience.
By removing the cluttered Vanilla elements,
ElixrUI focuses on immersion through smooth animations
body:
This is a clean, modern mod description tailored for a Cinematic Minecraft experience. Since you're using the name ElixrUI, I've framed it as a high-end interface overhaul.

🌿 ElixrUI: Cinematic Interface
ElixrUI is a complete overhaul of the Minecraft HUD, designed for players who want a clean, immersive, and high-fidelity visual experience. It replaces the cluttered "vanilla" icons with sleek, dynamic bars and a unique vertical navigation system.

✨ Key Features
🩸 Vitality & Immersion (Health & Nourishment)
Dynamic Status Bars: Replaces the classic hearts and drumsticks with minimalist, smooth-filling gradient bars located at the top-left.

Low Health Vignette: When your health drops below 25%, the screen edges darken with a pulsing vignette effect, simulating the struggle to stay conscious.

Desaturation Effect: When hunger falls below 50%, the screen subtly loses color, reflecting your character's weakening state.

Stomach Growl System: Immersive audio cues! Your stomach will audibly growl when hungry, with frequency increasing as you approach starvation.

🎒 Vertical Motion Hotbar
Sideways Navigation: The item slots have been moved to a sleek Vertical Panel on the right side of the screen.

Physics-Based Animation: Features a custom Spring & Damping system, making the selection indicator feel fluid and "bouncy" as you scroll.

Clean UI: The bar is tucked away to the side, freeing up the center of your screen for a clear view of the world.

🕰️ Cinematic Timekeeping
24-Hour World Clock: A minimalist time indicator located at the bottom-left of the screen.

Tick-Synced: Perfectly synchronized with the Minecraft day/night cycle.

Day/Night Icons: Subtle sun and moon indicators to help you track the time at a glance.
